name: FORMOSA
summary: FORMOSA has a prototype in CERN UJ12; the full detector is a candidate for the Forward Physics Facility. It is a dedicated forward millicharged-particle search.
detection_principle: Enhanced far-forward candidate-particle fluxes are searched for coincident weak-ionization light signals in multiple layers of scintillator bars.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
